notes:
v1.0.42 - stale FPS-cap neutralization for existing instances.

Verification found a real gap in the v1.0.41 FPS fix: existing instances
still carried an old cap in options.txt (maxFps:60) and the new launcher
no longer overwrote it when uncapped - Minecraft reads options.txt at
startup, so that stale 60 kept throttling the game even after updating.

Fixes:
- applyFrameCap now ALWAYS writes the maxFps line: 260 (vanilla
  "Unlimited") when no cap is configured, the snapped cap otherwise. A
  stale cap from any older launcher version can no longer survive a launch.
- The unlimitedFps branch (user-enabled "Unlimited" in Settings) now also
  neutralizes stale caps in options.txt, not just the mod config.

Confirmed on the real instance (Fabric -26.2-, options.txt had maxFps:60):
the next launch rewrites it to maxFps:260, and the bundled FPS Boost
auto-upgrades 1.0.12 -> 1.0.13 (ensureFpsBoost runs on every launch and
upgrades profiles carrying an older bundled jar).
